name: Rudraksha Reference
note: Per-planet mukhi (bead-face count) recommendation. Same non-prescriptive framing as gemstones.json - authenticity/sourcing concerns are arguably even more relevant here than for gemstones, given how widely mislabeled rudraksha beads are in the market.

verification_pass.method: Per-planet correspondences cross-checked against multiple classical/reference sources for consistency - these are widely standardized associations across Vedic astrology texts with little cross-source disagreement, unlike e.g. Pitra Dosha's definition.

user_review_pass.outcome: Not yet reviewed by the project owner - drafted and internally cross-checked only.

items.title: 1-Mukhi Rudraksha (Sun)
items.summary: The 1-face (mukhi) rudraksha bead traditionally associated with Sun.
items.effects: Worn (typically as a mala or pendant) to traditionally support Sun's significations. A 1-mukhi (single-faced) bead is traditionally considered the rarest and most powerful, and is priced/regarded accordingly - genuine specimens are uncommon. As with gemstones, authenticity varies significantly in the market - a trusted source matters more than for almost any other remedy here.
